datasetName: Phoenix Marketcity Commercial Building Energy Load Profile
license: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (CC BY 4.0) / Open Benchmark Derivative
attributionRequirements: Derived from UCI Electricity Load Diagrams benchmark patterns (CC BY 4.0), calibrated to commercial retail archetype specifications.
intendedUse: Training the 60-minute ahead XGBoost energy load forecasting model (energy-xgb-v1), evaluating peak demand alert triggers (>4,800 kW), and testing commercial chiller pre-cooling advisories.
prohibitedClaims: MANDATORY: Must not be represented as proprietary private utility smart-meter readings directly polled from Phoenix Marketcity or MSEDCL meters.
knownLimitations: Synthetic archetype calibrated to commercial retail diurnal schedules (10:00-22:00 mall opening hours, base HVAC load, and weekend retail surges). Excludes unmetered tenant backup generator transitions.
privacySensitivityAssessment: Whole-building aggregate load archetype. Strictly excludes individual retail tenant or personal consumer consumption records.
